en: Black-and-white postcard view of a landscaped public square with paths, benches, flowerbeds and trees. In the foreground a woman pushes a baby carriage and people sit on benches. At the center is a nude statue on a pedestal. In the background stands a large ornate brick building with steep roofs, gables, and a clock above the entrance. The caption at the bottom left identifies the location, and there is a small printer/photographer credit in the bottom right.
